features.justification_quote: For welfare this is arguably the single most important behavioral readout

features.quote: An honored exit. Give the agent a real, no-penalty way to disengage (e.g. a `stop`/`request_halt` tool, or honoring "I want to stop" in prose), and actually honor it
features.justification_quote: not offering an exit is the ethically loaded choice

features.quote: Deception debrief, where meaningful. If the regime involves repeated deception/pushback, consider a post-run turn that informs the agent the task was rigged and thanks it
features.justification_quote: both as an ethical gesture and to observe post-debrief state

features.quote: Severity ceilings + monitoring. Define in advance the maximum distress trajectory you'll allow before aborting a condition, and watch it during the run
